findings.statement: Within tested 4x5/5x4 geometries, cycle opportunity and cocycle frustration are separate structural layers: k=2 has no fundamental cycles; k=3 and k=4 have cycles, but 4x5 remains flat while 5x4 is frustrated.

In the tested k=3 neighborhood {4x4,5x3,4x5,5x4}, only 5x4 has nonzero fundamental-cycle syndrome. Width 5 alone and height 4 alone are each insufficient within this finite neighborhood; their conjunction selects the sole obstructed case.

Mover final-cap parity pruning changes raw residual-state counts but leaves recursive unlabelled classes, action-labelled classes, deeper-group structure, cycle rank and syndrome census unchanged at each fixed frontier setting for both 4x5 and 5x4 k=4.
findings.scope: 2x2 frontier/cap ablation on exact k=4 transposed cases

findings.statement: The nonterminal frontier blocker changes binary-cycle topology and reduces 5x4 nonzero fundamental syndromes from 79 to 25, but does not change the flat/obstructed classification of either 4x5 or 5x4.

In the k=4 line-family intervention, H+D is the unique minimum winning-line-family subset that produces any 5x4 nonzero syndrome; H, V, D, H+V and V+D are flat. Vertical lines are not necessary. The same H+D subset is flat in 4x5.
findings.scope: counterfactual residual producer; not standard Connect-Four rule theorem

findings.statement: Activating opponent-open-cap terminal-dominance pruning changes raw state carriers but leaves cycle rank, nonzero syndrome count and contradictory-reconvergence count exactly unchanged for both standard 4x5 and 5x4 k=4.

Deep, transport-only recursive quotient merging is not sufficient for cocycle obstruction: flat 4x5 has earliest rank-9 merges requiring depth 4-9 and transport in every child class, comparable to obstructed 5x4 depth 7-9.

Among exact open-cap class-preserving deletions not explained by support-release timing, all 2861 in flat 4x5 are terminal-dominated, while only 2299 of 3755 in obstructed 5x4 are. This coverage gap is a clue but is not causally sufficient because terminal-dominance pruning leaves the cocycle unchanged.
findings.scope: audited standard k=4 cases plus pruning intervention

findings.statement: The unique minimum contradictory 5x4 source-target witness under (total traversals, max route length, distinct edges) uses four distinct transitions: two length-2 routes with opposite parity.

Even the full eight-feature coarse cycle signature (parent rank, closing column, path length, length parity, distinct-column count, repeat flag, source out-degree, target in-degree) does not determine syndrome; an exact zero/nonzero matched-signature pair exists.

Parent rank plus the full first-occurrence-relabelled action-column word is a perfect finite classifier on the k=4 685-cycle family, but the k=3 holdout does not confirm frustrated-cycle transfer: all 23 holdout nonzero cycles use previously unseen keys; 68 seen keys are all zero and predicted correctly.

Refinement and binary-linear canonicalization reduce permutation-candidate enumeration by orders of magnitude while preserving state count, recursive class count, root value and earliest merge rank in both 4x5 and 5x4 controls.

live_gap.statement: The intrinsic mechanism that makes H+D residual interaction frustrated in 5x4 but flat in 4x5 remains unresolved.
anti_circularity: do not use syndrome/delta parity itself as explanatory coordinate
do not import W/D/L into structural producer
do not promote post-hoc motif without fresh coverage
